title: Kim H NDE 2804
content: It was a nice and sunny day. We went for a motorcycle ride with two other couples. I rode with my boyfriend of the time. We were at the back, before us rode my sister with her boyfriend. I can remember quite clearly that I saw her look behind her to check that we were along, when all of a sudden our bike flipped. I remember that I saw myself lying on the ground, and after not even a second, I saw my sister. She is a nurse and administered first aid. However, the longer that took, the more I felt being sucked upwards. I felt relaxed and calm, but at certain moments, I was really scared; I wanted to return and was prepared to do anything! Then I felt someone taking my hand, I didn't dare to look behind me, but I still did without wanting to. My nephew was standing there, the one who had a fatal car accident a few years ago. He spoke to me. Not with words, but with feelings. He told me to be careful and wary. I had to go back because I was too young. At that moment I did not want to return; I wanted to stay since I miss him dearly. He sent me back; it felt like I was thrown back in my body. I did not understand what was happening. Suddenly I saw my body again and a medical team were there with the ambulance; then everything around me turned to black. When I opened my eyes, my sister told me a few days later that I was yelling about wanting to go back to my nephew. I cannot remember that - everything is a blur in my memory. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 01/04/2005 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal How can I explain - in a way I understood that I was dead, but I could not really care. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I saw my nephew again. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once I was sucked into the sky. Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There appeared to be a slight fog in front of my eyes. Not in the space itself, but in front of my eyes. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Some things I cannot describe; there were noises that I knew, but could not recognize. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes It was like above the clouds, my deceased nephew standing there! He told me that I should be careful and wary, and that I should return because I was too young. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place een plaats boven de wolken die kalmte uitstraalde! What emotions did you feel during the experience? Frightened, calm, emotional, relaxed. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither I still do not know how to cope with this, why my nephew told me to be careful and wary. I suppose time will tell. Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Atheist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I believe more firmly that life continues after death, but just without the body and without the problems associated with this earthly life. What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believe more firmly that life continues after death, but just without the body and without the problems associated with this earthly life. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I distanced myself from certain people. After thinking about my nephew's words a few other matters were clearer. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I can feel certain things - you could call it premonitions. Usually these things actually happen. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? YES!! Seeing my nephew again will always be with me. I was never able to cope with his demise, but now I can accept it better. Every Sunday I visit his grave and tell him how much I miss him, that I found it very important that he was there for me, and that I wish him to be there when I die. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes A few days after the accident, I told my sister. She doubted my story. Then, two months later, I told my mother; she told me this was a normal experience. A friend of hers had also had a near-death experience. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I had read a good deal about NDEs and I have always thought that there probably is life after death. This experience made this belief a lot easier for me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I had read a good deal about NDEs and I have always thought that there probably is life after death. This experience made this belief a lot easier for me. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Before this experience I was afraid to die, I even had nightmares about it. But now it is like I know what is waiting for me, and that I should not be frightened.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'sucked upwards'; 'relaxed and calm' but sometimes 'really scared' and wanted to return.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as 'above the clouds' / 'a place above the clouds that radiated calmness' ("een plaats boven de wolken die kalmte uitstraalde!").

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Blackness occurred after seeing body again and medical team: 'then everything around me turned to black.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing body, upward pulling/sucking sensation, encounter with deceased nephew above clouds, boundary/being sends her back, sees body/medical team, then blackness and awakening later.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported a 'slight fog' in front of her eyes during the experience; heard 'noises that I knew, but could not recognize.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “the more I felt being sucked upwards.” / “He spoke to me. Not with words, but with feelings.” / “He sent me back; it felt like I was thrown back in my body.” / “It was like above the clouds… a place above the clouds that radiated calmness.”
